text: 西尔维娅一动不动地躺在诺曼怀里。他看起来像一头进食时受惊的野兽。这个比喻再恰当不过：女孩浑身是血，身上布满可怕的、如咬伤般的小伤口。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 282
text: Sylvia sprawls lifeless in Norman’s arms. He looks like a beast startled whilst feeding. And the observation is apt, for the girl is drenched in blood from terrible, bite-sized wounds.
